## Change

F1. Derive summon-frame options and matches from monster cards only. Ritual Spell subtype no longer leaks into Ritual monster filter; Ritual spell-property matching remains intact.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN exercises production indexed matcher and option derivation. Parent reviewed distinction and reran regression. Real AdvancedCardSearch + production catalog index/matcher Chromium harness verifies both controls and exact results; parent reran: 1 passed.
V2. Worker related: 34; full deck units: 224; contracts: 87. Typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Controlled-input component browser proof, not full application bootstrap. CI has sampled acquisition-stage failures; local checks do not claim full CI green.
title: fix(decks): separate Ritual summon frames from spell properties
